_note: Reference values for the alignment only. h_score (the log(P) column) is deliberately not recorded: it is a null-model p-value whose scale depends on how much genome the null could draw from and on whether --logp was given, so the same correct alignment scores about -1.4 against two chromosomes and about -9 against all 47. Comparing it across setups would fail runs that are in fact correct. What must reproduce is the locus, the F1 and the rank-2 haplotype.
